BiblicalUsage: Mishal is a city of Asher given to the Levites, named twice in the allotment of the land. It is named once in the border of Asher's inheritance, and once in the list of the cities the Levites received.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Levites' cities show God's provision: the tribe with no land of its own was given homes in every tribe's land, and Mishal was one of them.
